hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.sample|*.example|*.test) exit 0 ;; *.env*) echo "Blocked: editing .env files is not allowed" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" == *.ts ]] && pnpm prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null && pnpm eslint "$f" --fix --no-warn-ignored 2>/dev/null || true; }
